author: Nintendo of America
description:
Watch Nintendo Treehouse play Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy as they team up with Pikmin and good pup Oatchi to go for the best scores on three difficulty levels of Dandori Exams. The highest difficulty exam features an Empress Bulblax!

Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy release for Nintendo Switch 2 on November 12, 2026. Learn more: https://ninten.do/6001a2Kjv
